zh-CN.title: 让多个 Agent 在同一条 Stack 上安全协同：Stacked PR 深度实战
zh-CN.description: 解构在大模型高频产出场景下的大单体 PR 阻塞危机，深度推演基于 Layered Architecture 的 Stacked PR 编排模式、Owning Branch 职责归属与无冲突级联 Rebase 实操。
zh-CN.content:
TL;DR：引入自主编码 Agent 之后，团队通常面临的不是“代码写不出来”，而是“代码积压严重、评审严重滞后”。单次提交 800 行以上的大单体 PR 成为常态，审查者要么望而却步形成流水线塞车，要么闭眼放行埋下灾难隐患。解决这个吞吐瓶颈的唯一工程正解，就是推行 Stacked PRs（堆叠式 PR）。本文剖析如何将大特性垂直切片为严格单向依赖的分层分支链条，以及在 Agent 介入修改底层缺陷时，如何保障级联变基（Cascade Rebase）的安全无损。

一、 核心痛点：Agent 时代的“单体 PR 阻塞”

一个标准的现代功能开发（例如：引入本地 SQLite 离线缓存与多账户切换），往往横跨四个层次：

  1. 底层存储与 Schema 迁移（Database Layer）；
  2. 领域模型与仓库协议抽象（Repository Layer）；
  3. 业务用例与网络同步管道（Service Layer）；
  4. UI 视图与 ViewModel 绑定（Presentation Layer）。

如果让一个 Agent 顺着思路把这四层全部写完并提一个单一 PR，其变更往往包含 18 个文件、1200 行改动。这种 PR 对人类审查者而言无异于一场灾难：

  • 审查者如果对第 1 层的表结构有异议，第 2~4 层几乎必须全盘重构；
  • 这个 PR 会在审查队列中滞留数天，期间其他同事的代码不断合入 main，导致该分支反复陷入变基冲突的泥潭。

二、 堆叠式 PR（Stacked PR）的架构分层模型

Stacked PR 的核心思想是：“大特性拆分为原子微增量，上层分支永远建立在未合并的下层分支之上”。

gitGraph
    commit id: "main (基线)"
    branch pr-layer-1-db
    checkout pr-layer-1-db
    commit id: "PR 1: 核心表结构与 Migration (120行)"
    
    branch pr-layer-2-repo
    checkout pr-layer-2-repo
    commit id: "PR 2: 仓储协议与纯内存实现 (140行)"
    
    branch pr-layer-3-service
    checkout pr-layer-3-service
    commit id: "PR 3: 同步管道与冲突处理 (180行)"
    
    branch pr-layer-4-ui
    checkout pr-layer-4-ui
    commit id: "PR 4: SwiftUI 视图与交互绑定 (160行)"

每个 PR 的规模被严格压制在 100~200 行以内，只解决单一上下文的问题：

  • PR 1 仅仅包含 Migration 逻辑与 SQL 完整性单元测试；
  • PR 2 仅仅依赖 PR 1 导出的只读接口，审查者可以独立并行 Review；
  • 一旦底层被 Approve，依次按顺序快进合入 main。

三、 致命陷阱与黄金法则：Owning Branch 唯一职责准则

堆叠式 PR 最常见的灾难场景，发生在“越层提交（Layer Pollution）”：

当审查者在审查 PR 3 时，指出 PR 1 中的一个字段命名有歧义。此时开发者如果直接在 pr-layer-3-service 分支上顺手修改了底层模型，整个 Stack 的边界就彻底崩塌了！PR 1 无法独立合入，PR 3 包含了不相干的脏提交。

为了让 Agent 在 Stack 上安全协作，我们制定了团队必须无条件执行的黄金法则：

1
2
3
4

# STACK PR OWNING BRANCH CONSTRAINTS

1. 独立所有权原则：
   每个 PR 必须有且仅有一个清晰的 Owning Branch。所有针对该层抽象的修改，
   必须切回到该层的 Owning Branch 执行提交，严禁在上层分支越权修正！

2. 严格级联变基（Cascade Rebase）：
   当下层分支产生新的修订提交后，必须通过从底向上的自动化变基，
   将变更依次传递给所有上层分支。

四、 级联变基实战：一条命令解除冲突地狱

假设我们在底层 pr-layer-1-db 分支修复了一个类型声明缺陷，如何干净地将上层 3 个分支全部同步更新？

传统的使用 git merge 会产生无数混杂的 Merge Commit，使 Git 历史变成无法维护的毛线团。我们使用精细控制的 git rebase --onto 流程：

# 步骤 1：切回底层拥有者分支，追加修正提交
git checkout pr-layer-1-db
git commit -am "fix(db): ensure account_id has unique index"

# 步骤 2：记录变更前后的 commit hash
OLD_L1_HEAD="a1b2c3d"
NEW_L1_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

# 步骤 3：将 Layer 2 分支平移至新的 Layer 1 顶部
git checkout pr-layer-2-repo
git rebase --onto "$NEW_L1_HEAD" "$OLD_L1_HEAD" pr-layer-2-repo

# 步骤 4：同理，将 Layer 3 平移至 Layer 2 顶部
OLD_L2_HEAD="e4f5g6h"
NEW_L2_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git checkout pr-layer-3-service
git rebase --onto "$NEW_L2_HEAD" "$OLD_L2_HEAD" pr-layer-3-service

echo "✅ Entire stack cascading rebase completed cleanly without history pollution."

五、 总结

Stacked PR 不仅仅是一种 Git 分支管理技术，更是对抗软件工程熵增的组织防御术。

在 Agent 大规模普及的今天，能够将一个复杂庞大的系统需求，干净利落地切分为高内聚、低耦合、层层递进的微型 PR 链条，是一名资深架构师最不可替代的核心工程价值。

en.title: Enabling Secure Collaboration Among Multiple Agents on the Same Stack: In-Depth Practical Guide to Stacked PRs
en.description: This paper deconstructs the bottleneck crisis of large single-unit PRs in high-frequency production scenarios of large models, and deeply analyzes the stacked PR orchestration mode based on layered architecture, the ownership of Owning Branch responsibilities, and the practical operation of conflict-free cascading rebase.
en.content:
TL;DRAfter introducing a self-coding agent, the team usually doesn't face the problem of "not being able to write code," but rather..."Severe code backlog and significant delays in review process"Large single-entity PRs exceeding 800 lines have become the norm, causing reviewers to either shy away and create bottlenecks in the review process, or blindly approve them, potentially leading to future problems. The only engineering solution to this throughput bottleneck is to implement...Stacked PRsThis article analyzes how to vertically slice large features into hierarchical branch chains with strict unidirectional dependencies, and how to ensure the safety and integrity of cascade rebase when the agent intervenes to modify underlying defects.

I. Core Pain Point: "Single PR Blocking" in the Agent Era

A standard modern feature development (e.g., introducing local SQLite offline caching and multi-account switching) typically spans four layers:

  1. Underlying storage and schema migration (Database Layer);
  2. Domain Model and Repository Protocol Abstraction (Repository Layer);
  3. Business use cases and network synchronization pipeline (Service Layer);
  4. The UI view is bound to the ViewModel (Presentation Layer).

If an agent were to follow this line of thought, write all four layers, and submit a single PR, the resulting changes would often include...18 files, 1200 lines of changesThis kind of PR is nothing short of a disaster for human censors:

  • If the reviewer has objections to the table structure of the first level, the second to fourth levels almost must be completely restructured.
  • This PR will remain in the review queue for several days, during which time other colleagues' code will be continuously merged in.mainThis has led to the branch repeatedly getting bogged down in rebasing conflicts.

II. Layered Architecture Model of Stacked PRs

The core idea of ​​Stacked PRs is:"Major features are broken down into atomic micro-increments, and higher-level branches are always built upon unmerged lower-level branches."。

gitGraph
    commit id: "main (基线)"
    branch pr-layer-1-db
    checkout pr-layer-1-db
    commit id: "PR 1: 核心表结构与 Migration (120行)"
    
    branch pr-layer-2-repo
    checkout pr-layer-2-repo
    commit id: "PR 2: 仓储协议与纯内存实现 (140行)"
    
    branch pr-layer-3-service
    checkout pr-layer-3-service
    commit id: "PR 3: 同步管道与冲突处理 (180行)"
    
    branch pr-layer-4-ui
    checkout pr-layer-4-ui
    commit id: "PR 4: SwiftUI 视图与交互绑定 (160行)"

The size of each PR is strictly limited to...Within 100-200 linesIt only solves problems within a single context:

  • PR 1 only includes unit tests for Migration logic and SQL integrity;
  • PR 2 only depends on the read-only interface exported by PR 1, and reviewers can review it independently and in parallel.
  • Once the underlying layer is approved, merge them sequentially in fast forward.main。

III. Deadly Traps and the Golden Rule: The Owning Branch's Sole Responsibility Principle

The most common disaster scenario in stacked PRs occurs in"Layer Pollution"：

When the reviewer was reviewing PR 3, they pointed out an ambiguous field name in PR 1. If the developer directly...pr-layer-3-serviceI made a careless modification to the underlying model on a branch, and the boundaries of the entire Stack completely collapsed! PR 1 could not be merged in independently, and PR 3 contained unrelated dirty commits.

To ensure secure collaboration between agents on the stack, we established rules that the team must unconditionally follow.Golden Rule：

# STACK PR OWNING BRANCH CONSTRAINTS

1. 独立所有权原则：
   每个 PR 必须有且仅有一个清晰的 Owning Branch。所有针对该层抽象的修改，
   必须切回到该层的 Owning Branch 执行提交，严禁在上层分支越权修正！

2. 严格级联变基（Cascade Rebase）：
   当下层分支产生新的修订提交后，必须通过从底向上的自动化变基，
   将变更依次传递给所有上层分支。

IV. Cascaded Base Variable in Practice: One Command Resolves Conflict Hell

Assuming we are at the bottom layerpr-layer-1-dbThe branch fixes a type declaration defect. How can I cleanly synchronize and update all three parent branches?

Traditional usegit mergeThis would generate countless messy merge commits, turning Git history into an unmaintainable tangled mess. We use fine-grained control...git rebase --onto process:

# 步骤 1：切回底层拥有者分支，追加修正提交
git checkout pr-layer-1-db
git commit -am "fix(db): ensure account_id has unique index"

# 步骤 2：记录变更前后的 commit hash
OLD_L1_HEAD="a1b2c3d"
NEW_L1_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

# 步骤 3：将 Layer 2 分支平移至新的 Layer 1 顶部
git checkout pr-layer-2-repo
git rebase --onto "$NEW_L1_HEAD" "$OLD_L1_HEAD" pr-layer-2-repo

# 步骤 4：同理，将 Layer 3 平移至 Layer 2 顶部
OLD_L2_HEAD="e4f5g6h"
NEW_L2_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git checkout pr-layer-3-service
git rebase --onto "$NEW_L2_HEAD" "$OLD_L2_HEAD" pr-layer-3-service

echo "✅ Entire stack cascading rebase completed cleanly without history pollution."

V. Summary

Stacked PRs are not just a Git branch management technique, but also...Organizational defenses against entropy increase in software engineering。

In today's era of widespread agent adoption, the ability to cleanly and efficiently break down a complex and massive system requirement into a highly cohesive, loosely coupled, and progressively layered micro-PR chain is the most irreplaceable core engineering value of a senior architect.
